_comment: One table, two lookups: findOnPath (src/core/command-lookup.ts) and the
`detect` mode of hooks/redlog-relay.py answer 'where is this command on
PATH' independently, because the shell cannot call TypeScript and RedLog
will not spawn python3 to ask. test/command-lookup.test.ts and
test/tool-detection-shell.test.ts both build `dirs` under a temp directory,
put them on PATH in the order listed, then `relative` last as a RELATIVE
entry, and compare each lookup against `found` (a path under the temp
kinds: exec = executable file; plain = file without the execute bit;
dir = a directory; symlink = a link to `target` in the same directory.
